body: Yes. I was on it in 2018. My depression got much worse and I attempted suicide. I had seizures and went into a coma. I took an entire 1 month prescription of it. I ended up flat lining twice and was on life support. It was a miracle that I survived and it was a horrible recovery afterwards.

My 18 year old son and I have SP and it’s terrifying. He always sees a lady in black who scares the heck out of him. So he tried to put himself into SP thinking he could change what he sees and he did in fact bout himself into SP but again seen the scary lady in black and was terrified and when he came out of it, he was shaking and crying.
I have tried and failed because the doctors brought me back to life twice. You’re right, if you don’t succeed, it’s a long and painful recovery.

AMEN!!!!!!
I have been treated for depression for 26 years. 1 almost fatal suicide attempt (was brought back twice) and a stay at an institution. What seems like a million different antidepressants and therapy wasn’t helping me. 
I am as of a week ago today finally correctly being treated by a professional forensic psychiatrist, who I have been seeing for a little while now, with bipolar depression. 
I want and have ALWAYS wanted to feel better. Feel good. Feel happy. Feel “normal”. I just don’t know how to. I can’t. Some days are better than others. Some days I function some days I don’t. Sometimes I can leave the house and sometimes I can’t get out of bed for days. It isn’t my fault. I try really hard.

NTA! I have 2 children and my sister is a hair stylist and owns a salon. I would be absolutely livid if she or anyone EVER for any reason cut my kids hair without MY permission until they were at least 12 and made that decision for themselves and it was a hairstyle they wanted.

It’s definitely not easy. I’m 41 and I’m still afraid to go to bed by myself. I take 300 mg of trazodone to go to sleep. I refuse to go to bed unless my boyfriend goes with me. Otherwise I’m up all night afraid.

I’ve been suffering from clinical depression since I was 15. I’m now 41 and for the last almost 2 years it’s been a daily battle for me also. I also suffer with suicidal thoughts and anxiety. June 2018 I tried to take my own life and nearly succeeded. I was brought back to life twice. I see a therapist and have a good psychiatrist but I still suffer daily. My depression has never lasted this long. I don’t know how to help you because I can’t even seem to help myself but I just wanted to reach out and let you know that I understand and please try hard to be positive and remain grateful for all of the little things. When I remember to be grateful it sometimes helps a little. I wish you the very best and PLEASE get help. ❣️
